gaps.missing: Every rollback test uses changelog:false and a fixture where pre.json already exists. The restore branch that deletes a file the run created (previous content null) is never exercised. A failure after a CHANGELOG write is not exercised either.
gaps.reproduction: Use a fixture with no CHANGELOG.md for pkg-a and pkg-b and a config whose changelog is '@changesets/cli/changelog'. Inject a failure after the changelogs are written, for example make fs.rm of the changeset file throw. Assert the whole-tree snapshot equals the original, so the new CHANGELOG.md files are absent again. Repeat with preState set and no .changeset/pre.json, and assert pre.json is absent after the rejection.
